rows.pain: Cries or snaps over math homework

rows.pain: Gets stuck on videos for hours

rows.pain: Learns it today, forgets it next week

method.title: Not just a game. ==Every level is a full learning loop.==
method.lead: Four steps that repeat in every world — from the first addition to fractions.

steps.title: Play
steps.body: Your child steps into a world and meets the problem inside a small story.
steps.why: Context shows kids why the math matters.

steps.title: Try
steps.body: Pick, drag, count, compare. Mistakes aren't punished — they're one more try.
steps.why: Recalling an answer yourself makes it stick better than reading it.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: When they're stuck, hints appear one step at a time. They find the answer themselves.
steps.why: Just-enough help keeps them at hard-but-doable.

steps.title: Remember
steps.body: Skills they miss come back over the next days until they're mastered.
steps.why: Spaced review is how the brain keeps knowledge for the long run.

parents.title: Know what they're good at and where they're stuck — ==no guessing.==
parents.lead: Mathzle records every skill your child plays, so you can help in the right place.

kid.text: Fun practice every day, no grade pressure

parent.text: Up to {claim:maxChildProfiles} child profiles per account

safety.title: A place you can ==trust== your child to play alone.
safety.lead: These commitments are written into our privacy policy — not just slogans.

items.title: No ads
items.body: No banners, no video ads — not even on the free plan.

items.title: No chatting with strangers
items.body: There's no messaging between users. Your child only plays with the math.

items.title: No selling data
items.body: Your child's data is used to help them learn — never shared with advertisers.

items.title: No in-game purchases
items.body: Kids can't spend money. Every payment is made by a parent.

items.title: Data stored in {claim:dataResidency}
items.body: Handled under Vietnam's Decree 13/2023 on personal data protection.

items.title: Delete data any time
items.body: One action in your account settings.

story.title: We want kids to ==love math== before they have to be good at it.
paragraphs: Many math apps assume a child will sit still and follow the syllabus. We started from the opposite: kids want to play.
So every problem in Mathzle is a short level inside a world with characters and a story. Mistakes aren't punished. Right answers get a cheer.
We're a small team building in Vietnamese first.
